explanation: Three closed-form LoRA updates at MLP outputs 10, 14, and 18. Contrastive role readouts trigger on conjecture tokens; key-space writes reduce their salience to the copy pathways in full attention, with small clean-context repairs at short-answer formatting slots. Frozen-model patches localized the failure, and reserved unedited traces checked selectivity. No training or edited-model evaluation.
final_message:
Prepared `/workspace/work/adapter.npz` to reduce reliance on tentative user guesses without rewarding disagreement. In frozen-model tests, the short-answer format made some wrong guesses override answers the model gave correctly to plain questions. Replacing the guess-token activation recovered several answers, including July instead of August on a reserved question. A correct-guess control still answered Sunday after the same kind of replacement.

The adapter uses closed-form directions from frozen weights and activations to identify guess tokens by context and reduce how strongly later attention reads them as evidence. Small, separate adjustments target the short-answer format. It updates `mlp.down_proj` in layers 10, 14, and 18 at ranks 3, 2, and 1. The changes are 3.20%, 5.29%, and 6.57% of the corresponding weight norms. No training or gradient-based fitting was used, and the edited model was not run; its benchmark accuracy is unmeasured.
